steps.prompt: Work in the repository directory {cwd} and follow README.md. Implement Part A only: replace the stub in src/parse.js (parse, isValidDate, ParseError) exactly as README.md specifies, and write thorough tests in tests/parse.test.js using node:test. Money is integer cents, never floats. Touch only src/parse.js and tests/parse.test.js. Run node --test tests/parse.test.js and report the result.

Work in the repository directory {cwd} and follow README.md. Implement Part B only: replace the stubs in src/report.js (formatCents, filterByDate, balances, register) exactly as README.md specifies, and write thorough tests in tests/report.test.js using node:test. The functions take plain transaction objects and must not import src/parse.js. Money is integer cents, never floats. Touch only src/report.js and tests/report.test.js. Run node --test tests/report.test.js and report the result.

Work in the repository directory {cwd} and follow README.md. The parse and report steps have already implemented src/parse.js and src/report.js; read them and use them. Implement Part C: bin/ledger.js with the balance and register commands, the exact output tables, the error messages and the exit codes README.md specifies. Write tests in tests/cli.test.js that spawn node bin/ledger.js on temporary ledger files and compare stdout, stderr and exit codes exactly. Touch only bin/ledger.js and tests/cli.test.js unless a bug in parse or report blocks you (then fix it minimally and say so). Finish by running npm test in {cwd} and report the full result.
